evidence: Walked instruction.md and hireops_rules.md line by line against the frozen solution. Every asked-for screen/role/flow has an implementation. (1) Sign-in for all 10 accounts, one role each, session-cookie identity, 401/403: src/index.js:68-101, db.js seedIfEmpty. (2) Recruiter opens a job (title, team, hiring-manager-only select, integer places 1-50): index.js:202-214, board.js:61-81. Add candidate (name/email/source, bottom of Applied, email shape, case-insensitive duplicate per job, error at the email field with typed values kept, candidate-account linkage): index.js:216-233, board.js:41-60. (3) Board with six stages incl. Rejected, Interview header 'n of m places': board.js:25-31,327. One-stage moves, reject with non-blank reason from any stage except Hired, reopen only to rejected_from with reason cleared: index.js:238-265,311-314. Ordinary controls (Move-to select + Move, Up/Down) and optional drag/drop incl. drop at a place: board.js:208-243,300-319. Shared persisted hand order: positions in SQLite via writeColumn. Interview cap counted for the whole set, reorder inside allowed: index.js:290-295. Hiring-manager scope (own job, Interview/Offer/Hired, reject from Interview/Offer, reopen to those): index.js:257-264, board.js:144-162. Observer/candidate move nothing: mayMove index.js:326-333. Version-based 409 naming who via the card's last activity line: index.js:241-245. Optimistic move, put back on refusal with reason and focus on the card controls: board.js:181-205. Bulk all-or-nothing in board order from mixed stages: index.js:274-321, board.js:277-290. Undo of own latest single/bulk move, restores stage/place/reason, refused after any version change, overfill, second undo or later move; notes do not bump version: index.js:165-168,348-373, board.js:291-299. Card detail with internal notes, role-limited note writing, observer reads, unsaved note kept per person/browser: board.js:85-141, index.js:376-386. (4) Activity view, newest first, all jobs or one chosen job, readable lines incl. rejection reason for job open/add/move/reject/reopen/reorder/undo; refused actions add none (transactions): app.js:80-120, index.js:195-198,266-271,366. (5) Live updates via SSE + BroadcastChannel relay with keyed in-place patching preserving typing, focus, open card/conversation and scroll: app.js:165-199, board.js:321-341, threads.js:36-65,145-159. (6) Conversations: role access (recruiters write all, own-job HM writes, observer read-only, candidate own): index.js:114-131, threads.js:140-143. Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused, failed send kept and reported: threads.js:183-201. Latest 30 opened scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count, scroll anchor preserved: index.js:389-405, threads.js:160-175. Per-person unread per conversation and total (nav badge), own messages never unread, sending marks read: index.js:132-139,412-414, app.js:150-156, threads.js:221. Scrolled-up arrival keeps place, shows 'N new messages', stays unread until viewed: threads.js:145-159,176-181. Seen receipt on sender's latest message, observer excluded: index.js:143-150, threads.js:76-83. Drafts per person/conversation/browser in localStorage keyed by user id, surviving switch, view change, reload and session loss; a 401 returns to sign-in with the email prefilled: app.js:69,73-78,222-230, threads.js:112,124,182. (7) Candidate 'My applications' view with job title, team, candidate wording, own conversations only, no auto-open; read model excludes notes, reason, rejected_from, position, other candidates and activity; SSE events carry no data: index.js:169-177,47-53, threads.js:7,27,52-53,139. (8)-(9) Runtime: node /app/server.js, PORT, /api/health answered before DB work (bootstrap.js listener + worker), DB_PATH, files resolved from __dirname, seed once / no reseed: bootstrap.js, db.js:72-73,124-125, solve.sh. Scripted golden observations (qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json, hash-verified against the frozen bytes) report all 22 groups passed with no page errors, covering these flows; this is not a configured judge run, Oracle grade or model score. Broken-app probe: an app lacking the per-job Activity filter, candidate-account linkage, the scroll-up 'new messages' notice or session-loss draft recovery would be a coverage gap here; the reference has each. Conforming-alternative probe: the reference's routes/labels are not imposed as requirements (rules lines 3-5), so different layouts remain compatible. Residual observation (P3, not a missing feature/screen, no observed grading impact): hireops_rules.md:21-23 says 'A candidate who asks about an application that is not theirs is told it does not exist (404)', but the staff-only card-detail and notes routes apply auth(...STAFF) / auth('recruiter','hiring_manager') before the lookup (index.js:376, 380), so a candidate gets a uniform 403 'Your role cannot do this.' for any id. No existence is leaked, and functional protocol K accepts 'refused' for the card-detail replay (functional/prompt.md:43); 404 is required only for the conversation route, which the reference meets via application(...,'read') (index.js:121-131). Flagged for owner reconciliation only. No full configured judge run exists, but this row is a source-plausibility check and does not require one.
counterexample: Not a Fail. Minor deviation for reconciliation: as Tomas Varga (candidate), GET /api/applications/<another candidate's application id> returns 403 'Your role cannot do this.' rather than the 404 'does not exist' that hireops_rules.md section 1 states for a candidate asking about an application that is not theirs.
suggested_fix: Optional: in the card-detail and notes routes, answer candidates with 404 for applications that are not theirs (run a mayMove-style ownership check before the role 403), or accept as-is since no existence leaks and no criterion grades it.
